Questions

Frequently asked questions

Where is Aahana Enterprises located?

We're in Baramasya, Bokaro district, Jharkhand 828134 (Google plus code F8P5+3X Baramasya, Jharkhand). Tap Get directions to open the route in Google Maps.

Which paint brands do you sell?

We stock Berger Paints, Asian Paints & Birla Opus – interior and exterior emulsions, distempers, enamels, primers, wall putty and waterproofing products. For sanitary work we carry Astral pipes & fittings and Benson cisterns.

Are you open on Sundays?

Yes. We're open all 7 days of the week. Open all 7 days · 8:30 AM – 8:00 PM.

Can you help me choose colours for my house?

Of course. Browse our colour catalogue, then visit the store or send us photos of your walls on WhatsApp – we'll suggest shades, finishes and the right primer.

How much paint do I need for one room?

As a rough guide, one litre of interior emulsion covers about 60–70 sq. ft. with two coats. Use our paint calculator for an estimate, or WhatsApp us your room size.

Do you sell sanitary fittings and pipes too?

Yes – we're a paint and sanitary shop. We carry Astral CPVC, UPVC and SWR pipes, Drainmaster fittings, Benson flushing cisterns, taps and other bathroom fittings.

Planning to paint your home?

Send us your room size or a photo on WhatsApp – we'll suggest products, colours and the exact quantity you need.
